name: Design handoff record
summary: Before engineering starts, the design owner gets one record built from the approved design: every state, token, breakpoint and content rule either covered or flagged, with each unstated behaviour written as a question. The engineer confirms the questions are resolved.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own design, written from its published map of design work: the approved design, the component references, the tokens, the content rules and the interaction decisions, each with set column headers, checked against a fixed list of states and widths, with every gap written as a question for the design owner and no behaviour assumed.
